input: Which regions have the highest total revenue and what is the average order value in each of those regions?
output: SELECT c.Region, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue, AVG(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS AvgOrderValue FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID JOIN OrderDetails od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY c.Region ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC

input: What is the total freight cost for each shipper?
output: SELECT o.ShipVia, SUM(o.Freight) AS TotalFreightCost FROM Orders o WHERE o.ShipVia IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ShipVia;

input: What are the top 5 customers by the total freight cost they incurred?
output: SELECT TOP 5 c.CustomerID, SUM(o.Freight) AS TotalFreightCost FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID GROUP BY c.CustomerID ORDER BY TotalFreightCost DESC

input: What is the average shipping time for orders by country?
output: SELECT o.ShipCountry, AVG(DATEDIFF(day, o.OrderDate, o.ShippedDate)) AS AvgShippingTime FROM Orders o WHERE o.ShippedDate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ShipCountry;

input: Which categories have the highest average unit price?
output: SELECT TOP 3 p.CategoryID, cat.CategoryName, AVG(p.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice FROM Products p JOIN Categories cat ON p.CategoryID = cat.CategoryID GROUP BY p.CategoryID, cat.CategoryName ORDER BY AvgUnitPrice DESC;

input: Which customers have placed the most orders?
output: SELECT TOP 10 c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, COUNT(o.OrderID) AS OrderCount FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName ORDER BY OrderCount DESC;

input: How many units of each product are currently in stock?
output: SELECT p.ProductID, p.ProductName, p.UnitsInStock FROM Products p;

input: How many customers have placed multiple orders?
output: SELECT COUNT(CustomerID) AS CustomersWithMultipleOrders FROM (SELECT CustomerID, COUNT(OrderID) AS OrderCount FROM Orders GROUP BY CustomerID HAVING COUNT(OrderID) > 1) AS CustomerOrders

input: What are the total freight costs incurred by each customer?
output: SELECT c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, SUM(o.Freight) AS TotalFreightCost FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName

input: What is the average discount given on orders from each country?
output: SELECT ShipCountry, AVG(Discount) AS AvgDiscount FROM OrderDetails JOIN Orders ON OrderDetails.OrderID = Orders.OrderID GROUP BY ShipCountry ORDER BY AvgDiscount DESC;

input: Who is our most productive employee in terms of number of orders handled?
output: SELECT TOP 1 o.EmployeeID, COUNT(o.OrderID) AS OrderCount FROM Orders o GROUP BY o.EmployeeID ORDER BY OrderCount DESC

input: How many orders were shipped via each shipping method?
output: SELECT ShipVia, COUNT(*) AS ShippedOrdersCount FROM Orders GROUP BY ShipVia

input: Which categories have products with the highest unit price on average?
output: SELECT c.CategoryName, AVG(p.UnitPrice) AS AvgUnitPrice FROM Categories c JOIN Products p ON c.CategoryID = p.CategoryID GROUP BY c.CategoryName HAVING AVG(p.UnitPrice) > 50

input: What is the average discount given for each product category?
output: SELECT CategoryID, AVG(Discount) AS AvgDiscount FROM OrderDetails od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY CategoryID

input: Which employees have processed the most orders and what is the total revenue generated by those orders?
output: SELECT o.EmployeeID, COUNT(o.OrderID) AS TotalOrders, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM Orders o JOIN OrderDetails od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY o.EmployeeID ORDER BY TotalOrders DESC

input: How many orders have been placed by each employee and what is the average order quantity they handle?
output: SELECT o.EmployeeID, COUNT(o.OrderID) AS TotalOrders, AVG(od.Quantity) AS AvgOrderQuantity FROM Orders o JOIN OrderDetails od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY o.EmployeeID
